root_cause: In round 1 the Lootas ends up idle for two independent reasons, and nothing re-asks whether the central objective is the better use of an idle unit. (1) T7-26 _should_hold_for_heavy_bonus fires whenever the assigned marker is more than one move away and not 'high priority within 2 moves' — after LONE-TRIP/RACE-ARMY overrides pulled the unit off the centre (s7462: candidate 'Advance obj_center' 33.1 > chosen 'Move obj_nml_1' 30.5, override 'not going alone to obj_center') or even when the centre IS its target (s7460: Move obj_center 20.6" away -> Heavy hold). (2) A unit skipped from objective assignment (s7463: 'not racing for obj_nml_1 ... staying with the army'; its best candidate was Advance obj_center 27.9) falls through to the T7-42 corridor block guarding a far marker (obj_nml_2, 26" away). The Heavy bonus is worth ~3.3 extra hits for ONE shooting phase; the block delays one enemy unit. Reaching the centre pays every round: in the s7462 A/B replay (2 seeds) branch B's Lootas stood on obj_center at P2's round-2 command phase and held it (REMAIN 'holds obj_center'), which flipped Consecrate from hold_min only (+4) to hold_min+hold_more (+8) for P2 and cost P1 its hold_min +4 (P1's Gretchin had taken the centre in A); B also killed more (material +72). Once on the marker the unit stands still, so it gets its Heavy +1 to hit back from round 2 on — the hold-for-Heavy trade only loses the round-1 volley.
fix_summary: New plan-level pass _ranged_centre_redirect (FIX_RANGED_CENTRE, default 1.0), run once when the movement plan is built. Battle round 1 only. Finds the non-home objective within 4" of the board centre (same is_central test the VP estimator uses); skips if the enemy controls it. Eligible units: can Advance and Remain Stationary, have ranged weapons, are not melee seekers, carry no embarked units, have no plan earmark, and whose plan entry is idle: either action 'move' where T7-26 would hold them still for Heavy (probed with a new quiet flag), or a T7-42 corridor block guarding a marker OTHER than the centre (blocks now carry protects_objective). Keepers ('hold'), units already advancing/racing, screens of friendlies and centre-guarding blocks are never touched. Reach gate: the closest model must be able to stand in range (3.79") by its round-2 move: gap <= 2*M + 3.5. Mode: Advance only if two Normal moves would miss round 2 (gap > 2*M), else Normal move (keeps round-1 shooting). One unit per player per round (the closest), remembered in _ranged_centre_claims so a re-plan re-applies the same unit instead of adding another. The redirected entry gets assign_pass 'ranged_centre', which also bypasses the three round-1 hold checks (threat hold, MOV-1 hold-for-shooting, T7-26 Heavy) for that unit only. Logs [RANGED_CENTRE] and a thinking step when it fires. Value 0 restores the base exactly (the pass is not called; protects_objective/quiet flag are inert).

fires: Replays (horizon end of round 2, both players, counted from decision-record thinking steps): s7462 P2 1 (Lootas Gamma, Heavy hold -> Advance centre), s7463 1 (Lootas Alpha, block -> Advance centre), s7460 1 (Lootas Alpha, Heavy hold -> Advance centre); 0 in all 5 guardrail replays. Bench (mirror_orks_2000_postdeploy, 1 pair, candidate seat): 0 fires in both games (seed 93101, margin -23 in both seats, 589 actions each: candidate played identically to base). Why: the bench Orks_2000 postdeploy list has no Lootas; in round 1 no unit of either player Heavy-holds or takes a T7-42 corridor block (round-1 movement records: Gretchin get screen_protect, everything else move/advance/hold), and by P2's round-1 turn the centre is already enemy-held (OC 3). So this design does NOT reach the bench as it stands.
risks: Rounds 3-5 / secondaries: the pass never runs after round 1, so it cannot hold units back later (the round-2 FAR_TRIP/OVERCOMMIT failure mode); it only moves one idle unit FORWARD, which tends to help Centre-Ground / Engage-on-All-Fronts / Beacon-type cards (a unit outside its deployment zone, in the middle). Once on the centre the unit is a normal holder: it stays still (so regains Heavy +1 to hit), and HELD_DUP/REINFORCE-INSURANCE treat it like any holder. Costs: (a) the round-1 volley (Advance = no shooting for non-Assault weapons) — small for Lootas (~1 expected damage in the replays); (b) a 10-model T5 5+ unit standing in the open middle draws fire — in s7462 B it went from 10 to 2-3 HP by end of round 2 in one seed, so the centre may be lost again in round 3 and the unit is worth fewer points later (Assassination-type cards); (c) with several Heavy shooters only one goes (cap), so overcommit is bounded, but the redirected unit may not be the one the critic named (s7462 picked Gamma, not Alpha); (d) an army with a big round-1 alpha strike (e.g. Custodes vs a fragile ranged unit 9" from the centre after the Advance) can delete it; the enemy-held-centre skip does not see enemy units that will ARRIVE first. Bench reach was measured only on the Orks mirror; whether any Custodes unit qualifies (Custodes mirror / asym fixtures) is NOT verified. Untested: boards whose central objective sits >4" off the board centre (pass then does nothing).
